name: 威尔·贝利斯-布朗
name_full: 威尔·贝利斯-布朗 Will Bayliss-Brown
introduction: Will Bayliss-Brown is a British Actor & Stunt Performer with a commanding physical presence, an elite sporting background & extensive experience across major International Film, Television & Streaming Productions.A Highland Games Champion & former professional Rugby player standing 6’2″, Will is ideally cast in roles where physical authority, athleticism & immediate screen credibility are essential: Warriors, Special Forces, Police & Military figures, Enforcers, Athletes & imposing character roles.His recent credits include Highlander (featured speaking roles as a McLeod Warrior & Wrestler opposite Henry Cavill, Karen Gillan & Kevin McKidd, directed by Chad Stahelski), How to Train Your Dragon 2 (featured scene opposite Cate Blanchett), Star Wars: Starfighter (featured speaking & fighting role, directed by Shawn Levy), The Beekeeper 2, Viva La Madness (Guy Ritchie, opposite Vinnie Jones & Jason Statham), Hijack (opposite Idris Elba), Supacell, Mobland & The Diplomat.He also brings proven comedic range, with roles in Extraordinary opposite Julian Barratt, Big Mood & We Are Lady Parts, & has worked as a Body Double for John Cena (Heads of State), Adam Copeland & Stephen Farrelly.Will is a fully trained Screen Combat Performer, certified by the ACTT across multiple weapon disciplines, trained at the British Action Academy & holding Advanced Firearm Training for Film & Television. He performs with the Combat International & True Edge Fight Teams & appears live at festivals with fight & fire whip performances.Professional, disciplined & production-ready, Will is a committed & reliable performer for Film, Television & Streaming Productions requiring strength, action capability & authentic screen presence.
